sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM CNTRL ND TO NWRN MN
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PART OF THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW REGIME WILL PERSIST ACROSS MUCH OF CANADA AND THE NRN TIER OF STATES...ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF HIGH-LATITUDE UPPER LOWS OVER THE GULF OF AK/NRN BRITISH COLUMBIA AND NRN QUEBEC. THE MOST SALIENT FEATURE --WITH RESPECT TO SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT-- WITHIN THIS SYNOPTIC-SCALE PATTERN APPEARS TO BE A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH ALONG THE ALBERTA/SASKATCHEWAN BORDER WHICH WILL TRANSLATE ESEWD INTO WRN ONTARIO BY 22/12Z. THIS SYSTEM WILL BE ATTENDED BY A MIGRATORY SURFACE LOW DEVELOPING FROM SWRN SASKATCHEWAN TO WRN ONTARIO AND A COLD FRONT WHICH WILL ADVANCE SEWD THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. A WARM FRONT WILL PRECEDE THE SURFACE LOW...MOVING NWD THROUGH THE DAKOTAS AND UPPER MS VALLEY.

sections.title: CNTRL ND INTO NWRN MN THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: THE ISALLOBARIC RESPONSE TO THE MIGRATORY SHORT-WAVE TROUGH AND SURFACE LOW WILL INDUCE STRENGTHENING SLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW AND A RESULTANT INCREASE IN BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE BENEATH STEEPENING MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...YIELDING AFTERNOON MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG. DCVA ATTENDANT TO THE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH WILL AUGMENT LOW-LEVEL UPLIFT INVOF THE SURFACE LOW AND ALONG THE COLD FRONT TO FOSTER WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS OVER WRN OR CNTRL ND BY MID TO LATE AFTERNOON. GIVEN A KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT FEATURING PRONOUNCED VEERING OF WINDS WITH HEIGHT AND AROUND 50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...SUPERCELLS APPEAR LIKELY WITH A RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES. MERGING STORM-SCALE OUTFLOWS WILL POTENTIALLY LEAD TO UPSCALE GROWTH OF STORMS INTO AN MCS WITH A HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT SPREADING EWD THROUGH THE RED RIVER VALLEY THIS EVENING INTO TONIGHT.

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: THE FORECAST SCENARIO REMAINS A BIT MORE UNCERTAIN THAN THAT ACROSS ND OWING TO THE ABSENCE OF AN APPRECIABLE LARGE-SCALE FORCING MECHANISM. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THE LEE TROUGH ACROSS FAR ERN WY INTO NERN CO AND PERHAPS AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY REMNANT FROM ONGOING STORMS OVER THE NEB SANDHILLS WILL SERVE AS FOCI FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. THE AMBIENT ENVIRONMENT WILL BE CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE AMOUNTS OF INSTABILITY AND VERTICAL SHEAR AND THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR ORGANIZED STORM MODES --INCLUDING SUPERCELLS-- WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS PERSISTING INTO THIS EVENING. ...MID MO VALLEY INTO ERN KS AND THE OZARKS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING... REGIONAL RADAR AND SURFACE OBSERVATIONS INDICATE A NUMBER OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND A COUPLE OF CONVECTIVELY INDUCED VORTICITY MAXIMA PRESENT WHICH WILL INTERACT WITH A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS TO PROMOTE WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS BY AFTERNOON. THE STRONGEST STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL INTO THIS EVENING. ..MEAD/JIRAK.. 07/21/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MODELS INDICATE THAT A SEASONABLY STRONG MID/UPPER JET...NOW EXTENDING FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND ST. LAWRENCE VALLEY REGION INTO THE NORTH ATLANTIC...WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT EASTWARD DURING THIS FORECAST PERIOD. AS DEEP LAYER FLOW FIELDS WEAKEN ACROSS THE NORTHEAST...THEY WILL REMAIN GENERALLY WEAK ELSEWHERE ...BUT STRONGEST IN A CONFLUENT...LARGELY ZONAL...REGIME ACROSS THE NORTHEASTERN PACIFIC THROUGH THE CANADIAN/U.S. BORDER AREA. A SIGNIFICANT EMBEDDED SHORT WAVE IMPULSE THAT SUPPORTED CONSIDERABLE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY ACROSS SOUTHERN ALBERTA AND SASKATCHEWAN...AS IT DUG TO THE LEE OF THE CANADIAN ROCKIES...IS FORECAST TO REMAIN PROGRESSIVE AND GRADUALLY TURN EASTWARD ALONG AND JUST NORTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...INTO WESTERN ONTARIO BY LATE TONIGHT. THE PRIMARY LOW-LEVEL BAROCLINIC ZONE ASSOCIATED WITH THE DEPARTING EASTERN IMPULSE APPEARS LIKELY TO STALL ACROSS PARTS OF THE LOWER GREAT LAKES INTO NEW ENGLAND. BUT AT LEAST SOME DRYING ASSOCIATED WITH A LEADING...WEAK CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED BOUNDARY APPEARS TO HAVE GENERALLY SHIFTED TO THE SOUTH OF THE STRONGER RESIDUAL MID-LEVEL FLOW...INTO THE OHIO VALLEY AND NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST REGION. STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: STRENGTHENING LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION AND VERTICAL SHEAR NEAR A DEVELOPING FRONTAL WAVE ASSOCIATED WITH THE APPROACHING UPPER IMPULSE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO INCREASING CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT. GIVEN SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION...THE ENVIRONMENT APPEARS LIKELY TO BECOME CONDUCIVE TO ORGANIZED STORM DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS AND AN UPSCALE GROWING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...PARTICULARLY ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN NORTH DAKOTA INTO NORTHWEST MINNESOTA. THE MOISTURE CONTENT OF THE AIR MASS ACROSS THIS REGION...HOWEVER...IS SOMEWHAT LOW /SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE 50S/...AND THE POTENTIAL FOR SUBSTANTIVE FURTHER MOISTENING REMAINS UNCLEAR. STILL...MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES APPEAR STEEP ENOUGH...GIVEN MARGINAL MOISTURE...TO SUPPORT SLIGHT RISK PROBABILITIES...WITH HIGHEST PROBABILITIES ACROSS NORTH CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA...MAINLY IN 23-02Z TIME FRAME.

sections.title: CENTRAL APPALACHIANS INTO NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST
sections.text: WEAK LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION SUPPORTING ONGOING STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS INTO THE TENNESSEE VALLEY IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP EASTWARD ACROSS THE NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST REGION BY THIS EVENING. DESPITE THE WEAK NATURE OF THE LOWER/MID-LEVEL WIND FIELDS...AND LAPSE RATES THAT APPEAR MODEST AT BEST...CAPE MAY BECOME MODERATELY LARGE...AND HEAVY PRECIPITATION LOADING IN STRONGER CELLS MAY SUPPORT AT LEAST LOCALIZED POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: SOUTHERN PLATEAU
sections.text: THUNDERSTORM PROBABILITIES WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY HIGH TODAY ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION ASSOCIATED WITH A SIGNIFICANT WEST NORTHWESTWARD MIGRATING UPPER WAVE. EVEN IF SUBSTANTIAL EARLY DAY CLOUD COVER LIMITS SURFACE HEATING...SUB-CLOUD TEMPERATURE/ DEW POINT SPREADS WILL PROBABLY BECOME LARGE ENOUGH TO SUPPORT THE RISK FOR AT LEAST LOCALIZED STRONG CONVECTIVE SURFACE GUSTS TO THE NORTH OF THE ONGOING STORM CLUSTER NOW SPREADING WESTWARD THROUGH THE LOWER COLORADO VALLEY. ..KERR/LEITMAN.. 07/21/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SURFACE BASED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY BETWEEN 20-21Z OVER NWRN ND. SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL APPEAR LIKELY WITH THE INITIAL STORMS...BUT ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. SOME OF THE STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY CONSOLIDATE INTO LINE SEGMENTS THIS EVENING WHICH MAY ALSO ENHANCE THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS AFTERNOON A COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM EXTREME NWRN ND SWWD INTO ERN MT. A WARM FRONT STRETCHES FROM SRN MN NWWD THROUGH CNTRL AND NWRN ND WHERE IT INTERSECTS THE COLD FRONT. THE WARM FRONT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE NEWD...ALLOWING THE ATMOSPHERE TO DESTABILIZE FARTHER EAST THROUGH CNTRL AND EVENTUALLY ERN ND...WHILE THE COLD FRONT ADVANCES SEWD. LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS DEWPOINTS HAVE INCREASED TO LOW-MID 60S OVER THE WRN HALF OF ND...AND APPEARS TO BE LARGELY A RESULT OF MIXING DOWNWARD OF RICHER MOISTURE EVIDENT ABOVE THE SFC ON THE 12Z BISMARK SOUNDING. STEEP LAPSE RATES ARE ALSO IN PLACE...AND AS TEMPERATURES CLIMB THROUGH THE 80S...MLCAPE SHOULD APPROACH 2000 J/KG WHILE SBCINH CONTINUES TO WEAKEN. WV IMAGERY INDICATES A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING SEWD THROUGH SRN SASKATCHEWAN AND APPROACHING NRN ND. THIS FEATURE WILL AUGMENT DEEP FORCING ALONG THE COLD FRONT...LIKELY SUPPORTING THUNDERSTORM INITIATION OVER NWRN ND BY 21Z. VERTICAL SHEAR FROM 40-50 KT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH LARGE HAIL LIKELY. ISOLATED TORNADOES ALSO CANNOT BE RULED OUT...ESPECIALLY OVER THE NRN HALF OF ND WHERE HIGHER DEWPOINTS AND LOWER LCLS ARE MORE LIKELY TO BE MAINTAINED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY BE REQUIRED FOR PORTIONS OF NERN WY AND WRN SD IF CONVECTION ORGANIZES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF WRN SD INTO NERN WY. DESPITE THE RELATIVELY WEAK BUOYANCY ISOLATED HIGH BASED TSTMS HAVE EVOLVED FROM HARDING COUNTY SD...SWWD INTO SRN CAMPBELL COUNTY WY. MID LEVEL NWLY FLOW ON THE ORDER OF 30KT MAY PROVIDE SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED UPDRAFTS THAT WOULD SPREAD SEWD THIS EVENING. LATEST DATA SUGGESTS CLOUD BASES ARE AROUND 650MB WHICH FAVORS GUSTY DOWNDRAFTS IN ADDITION TO HAIL. WHILE LARGE SCALE SUPPORT IS QUITE WEAK ACROSS THIS REGION IF CONVECTION WERE TO EXPAND IN AREAL COVERAGE/INTENSITY A WW MAY BE REQUIRED GIVEN THE MODEST SHEAR ENVIRONMENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL SPREAD ACROSS WRN INTO CNTRL ND OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL DISCRETE SUPERCELLS HAVE EVOLVED ACROSS WRN ND EARLY THIS EVENING ALONG ERN PLUME OF VERY STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT. THIS ACTIVITY IS GRADUALLY SPREADING SEWD AND IS BEGINNING TO ENCOUNTER AN INCREASINGLY MOIST AND COOLER BOUNDARY LAYER WHICH MAY ENCOURAGE BASES TO LOWER AS THEY INGEST MORE BUOYANT AIR MASS. LATEST WDSSII MESH ALGORITHM SUGGESTS VERY LARGE HAIL...AT TIMES IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES...IS NOTED WITH SUPERCELL OVER WRN MORTON COUNTY. THIS STORM IS DIGGING SE AND COULD EXPERIENCE UPWARD GROWTH AS IT APPROACHES THE GREATER BIS REGION. IF TRAILING CONVECTION OVER GRANT COUNTY CONTINUES TO INCREASE THERE MAY BE A NEED TO ADD SRN MOST COUNTIES OF ND TO CURRENT WW 428. ..DARROW.. 07/21/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT IS GRADUALLY DECREASING ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO PRIMARY CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS HAVE EVOLVED ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS THIS EVENING. THE SRN MOST CLUSTER IS PROPAGATING SEWD ALONG THE ND/SD BORDER AND IS GRADUALLY DECREASING IN INTENSITY AND CONTRACTING IN COVERAGE. FARTHER NORTH...A MORE EXPANSIVE CLUSTER OF STORMS IS SPREADING INTO NERN ND AND WILL SOON EXIT WW428. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD PROPAGATE ACROSS NERN ND INTO NWRN MN OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS LLJ VEERS AND INCREASES INTO THIS REGION. HOWEVER...ONLY ISOLATED LARGE HAIL OR PERHAPS LOCALLY SEVERE WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS AND FOR THIS REASON DO NOT ANTICIPATE ANOTHER WATCH DOWNSTREAM. ..DARROW.. 07/22/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
